name: Ohio
source: Ohio Digest of Motor Vehicle Laws (publicsafety.ohio.gov)
official_test_languages_evidence: The test is 40 multiple-choice questions... and is available in American Sign Language (ASL), Arabic, Chinese, English, French, Haitian Creole, Japanese, Russian, Somali, and Spanish.
You may use your own interpreter for all other languages by scheduling an appointment at a Driver Exam Station only.
